answer: Coordination Ledge Pricing: each agent's message carries a fresh, verifiable sampling receipt proving it read a randomly chosen shard of the shared state. Reusing a receipt is rejected, so forging N distinct identities requires N distinct reads, each paying storage and query costs in shale credits. A juniper-tier audit randomly re-executes receipts, slashing deposits on failure. Attacker cost scales linearly per identity, recovered only through genuine coordination.
